command.opencraft.help: /opencraft ask <message> — chat with your nearest AI assistant; /opencraft ask <name> <message> — chat with a specific assistant by name (Tab to complete; use name(coords) when names repeat); /opencraft answer <reply> — reply to an assistant's confirmation question; /opencraft interrupt — abort the assistant's running task (re-ask right away when it's stuck); /opencraft summon — summon one (binds the nearest unbound block); /opencraft dismiss [all] — dismiss nearest/all; /opencraft status — list all assistants; /opencraft reset [all] — clear nearest/all memory. Right-click an AI Logo Block to configure it in-game; each block binds at most one assistant, and you can have many at once.
command.opencraft.answer.blank: Please type your reply (/opencraft answer <your reply>).
command.opencraft.answer.none: There is no question waiting for your answer right now.
command.opencraft.answer.ok: Your reply was passed to the assistant — it continues.
command.opencraft.interrupt.none: This assistant has no task running right now.
command.opencraft.interrupt.ok: Aborted the assistant's current task — you can ask again now.
command.opencraft.ask.question: 🤔 Wanted to confirm: %s (reply /opencraft answer <your reply> to continue)

screen.opencraft.config.title: AI Assistant Settings
screen.opencraft.config.chat.empty: No messages yet — type a message to start chatting (an assistant is auto-summoned to this block if none is bound)
screen.opencraft.config.save.tooltip: Save to this AI Logo Block (takes effect immediately)
screen.opencraft.config.base_url.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1
screen.opencraft.config.api_key.tooltip: The key is stored only in the block and never shown in plaintext.
screen.opencraft.config.change_key.toolt: Tick to enter a new key; leave blank to clear.
screen.opencraft.config.model.tooltip: Model name used for chat completions.
screen.opencraft.config.agent.tooltip: Determines the assistant's AI behavior: chat_agent = pure chat; general_agent = act like a real player: walk/mine/place/craft/give items. The assistant body is always a real player that joins the server like a client.
screen.opencraft.config.name: Assistant Name
screen.opencraft.config.name.tooltip: The assistant's name: shown in chat prefixes and its name tag, and used by the model to refer to itself.
screen.opencraft.config.max_history.tool: How many recent messages are kept in memory.
screen.opencraft.config.max_distance.too: Max distance for tool actions (movement/mine/place targets must be within this of the owner).
screen.opencraft.config.no_permission_hi: View only — you need operator permission to save changes.
command.opencraft.config.saved: Saved to this AI Logo Block and applied now!
